subject: Follow-up: Redwood demo & procurement next steps

Subject: Follow-up: Redwood demo & procurement next steps

Jordan -

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our call and proposed next steps to keep procurement moving: 

What we covered
- Demo highlights: low-latency hosted inference, Dedicated reserved pools for steady throughput, and Private (VPC) for regulated workloads.
- Packaging: Hosted (on-demand or small commit), Dedicated (monthly commit/reserved), Private (enterprise deployment + contract).
- Security: SOC 2, optional on-prem KMS, and audit logging available for Dedicated/Private.

Action items / Questions for Optima
1) Preferred commercial path: are you leaning toward starting on Hosted (faster time to value) or going straight to Dedicated/Private?
2) Procurement method: do you require PO-based invoicing or can you start on card/marketplace? If PO, do you have a minimum monthly threshold?
3) Marketplace: any preference for AWS Marketplace procurement? This can simplify internal procurement for some teams.

I've attached a short pricing/options PDF and a procurement checklist that maps our packaging to typical PO/invoice requirements - see attachments.

Suggested next steps
- You confirm preferred billing flow (PO vs card vs marketplace) and who in procurement we should loop in.
- If Dedicated/Private is preferred, we'll share lead times and a draft SOW.
- If Hosted with commit is desirable, we can provide commit tiers and a simple invoice flow to satisfy procurement.

Happy to jump back on a short call with procurement if that helps.

Best,

Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Marissa -

Thanks for the clear recap and the materials. A few Procurement & Security questions from our side as we evaluate: 

1) Billing / PO policy: Optima typically requires a PO for any vendor invoicing over $10k/month. We can pay by card for smaller pilots. Will Redwood accept PO-based invoicing for Dedicated or committed Hosted tiers, and what are the minimums?

2) Marketplace: Would purchasing through AWS Marketplace satisfy our procurement team? Are the same SKUs (hosted vs dedicated) available there or is it hosted-only?

3) Lead times: If we opt for Dedicated, what is the typical lead time to reserve capacity + perform initial onboarding? Also need to confirm what security artifacts you can provide (SOC 2 report, penetration test summary).

4) Data residency: We prefer US-region only for production PHI-adjacent workloads. Can Dedicated/Private be pinned to US-only hosts?

If it helps, our procurement lead is Sarah Nguyen (sarah.nguyen@optimahealth.com) - I'll introduce her once we've narrowed the billing path.

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@optimahealth.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 01 Mar 2026 11:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Follow-up: Redwood demo & procurement next steps

Jordan -

Great questions. Below is a concise mapping to make procurement's review faster, and a proposed commercial path we see working well for customers with similar constraints.

Billing / PO policy
- PO-based invoicing: We support invoice/PO billing for customers on monthly commitments (Dedicated and committed Hosted tiers). Typical internal threshold is $10k/month to enable PO billing; below that, card is the simpler path.
- Marketplace: Hosted SKUs are available on AWS Marketplace today (metered and committed options). Dedicated and Private deployments are handled via direct contract/invoice (marketplace not commonly used for Dedicated).

Lead times / onboarding
- Hosted (on-demand): immediate - can start within hours after signup; simplest for pilots.
- Hosted (committed): can provision billing and commitment terms within 1-3 business days once PO/contract is in place.
- Dedicated: typical lead time 3-6 weeks for capacity reservation, network setup, and onboarding (shorter if opting for our Dedicated Fast-Start program).
- Private (VPC/on-prem): 6-12+ weeks depending on network and security reviews.

Security & data residency
- SOC 2 Type II report available; we can provide an attestation and penetration test summary for procurement and security.
- Dedicated and Private can be pinned to US regions only; we support region restrictions and contractual commitments for data residency.

Recommended path for Optima (based on the call)
- Option A (fastest): Start Hosted (on-demand or small commit) to pilot. Use card for pilot spend < $10k/month.
- Option B (procurement-friendly): Commit to a monthly hosted tier at or above $10k/mo to allow PO/invoice billing while getting a discounted commit price. This avoids the Dedicated lead time while satisfying procurement.
- Option C (production scale + isolation): Move to Dedicated with monthly reserved capacity once load and latency needs justify it.

Next steps I can run from our side
- Share a one-page comparison of Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private for procurement (cost, lead time, compliance). Attached: pricing_table_snapshot.csv.
- If you confirm PO-path and approximate monthly target, I will loop in our Finance & Legal to prepare terms and a simple invoice flow.
- If helpful, we can schedule a short call with Dylan (SE) to answer latency and capacity questions for the Dedicated path.

Please let me know which option you want to pursue and I will introduce the appropriate internal contacts (Finance/Legal/Dedicated onboarding).

Best,

Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | (415) 555-0142

Attachments: pricing_table_snapshot.csv
